sections.text:
[Effects]
Nullifies magic damage.
Reduces magic Ability Power by 4XL.

[Activation]
When magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
S+
Activation rate scales with the number of Time elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of M+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
